Rat Caught Stealing Ornaments Worth Lakhs in Karnataka

A rat was apprehended in Karnataka after allegedly stealing gold ornaments valued at Rs 10 lakh from a jewellery shop in Tumakuru. The incident was captured on CCTV footage, showing the rodent in the act. The rat reportedly hid in a burrow after the theft. Authorities recovered the stolen items.
